mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adi_index_task (kb_uuid, doc_uuid, user_id, segment_uuid, target_type, task_type, version, status) VALUES (#{task.kbUuid}, #{task.docUuid}, #{task.userId}, #{task.segmentUuid}, #{task.targetType}, #{task.taskType}, #{task.version}, 'pending') ON CONFLICT (doc_uuid, segment_uuid, target_type, task_type) DO UPDATE SET version = excluded.version, user_id = excluded.user_id, update_time = now() WHERE adi_index_task.status = 'pending'
mapper.select: UPDATE adi_index_task t SET status = 'running', update_time = now() WHERE t.id = ( SELECT p.id FROM adi_index_task p WHERE p.status = 'pending' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM adi_index_task r WHERE r.doc_uuid = p.doc_uuid AND r.status = 'running') AND pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('idx:' || p.doc_uuid)) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING t.id, t.kb_uuid, t.doc_uuid, t.user_id, t.segment_uuid, t.target_type, t.task_type, t.version, t.status, t.fail_reason, t.create_time, t.update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE adi_index_task SET status = #{status}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adi_index_task WHERE doc_uuid = #{docUuid} AND status = 'running')
mapper.update: UPDATE adi_index_task SET status = 'pending', update_time = now() WHERE status = 'running' AND update_time < now() - (#{minutes} || ' minutes')::interval
